summary: Push Notification Prompt and Spotlight Carousel testing. Carousel features work correctly (navigation arrows, auto-advance, product display). Push notification prompt CANNOT be tested in headless browser due to Notification.permission being 'denied' by default. Backend API tests pass for subscription endpoints. Found 2 bugs.

issues.description: Push notifications admin endpoints return 500 Internal Server Error due to ImportError: cannot import name 'get_current_admin' from 'server'. The push_notifications.py router tries to import a function that doesn't exist in server.py.

Push notifications router has double /api prefix. The router is defined with prefix='/api/notifications' but is included in api_router which adds another /api, resulting in /api/api/notifications/* URLs.
issues.reproduction: Templates endpoint is at /api/api/notifications/templates instead of /api/notifications/templates
issues.affected_test: N/A - tests work around this by using correct URL

issues.description: Push notification prompt cannot be tested in headless browser environments because Notification.permission is 'denied' by default in headless Chromium. The component correctly checks this and doesn't show the prompt. For full testing, use real browser or mobile device testing.

action_items: FIX BUG-001: Add get_current_admin function to server.py or update push_notifications.py to use the correct admin authentication function (likely require_admin)
FIX BUG-002: Remove /api prefix from push_notifications.py router since it's already included in api_router which adds /api

rca_of_issue: BUG-001 RCA: The push_notifications.py router imports 'get_current_admin' from server.py (line 139, 169, 209) but this function doesn't exist. The server.py has 'require_admin' dependency instead. Fix: Replace 'get_current_admin' with 'require_admin' in push_notifications.py.
